description: This file defines classes and functions for representing and manipulating parse trees of a scripting language, including nodes for literals, identifiers, expressions, statements, and comments, with JSON serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: ParseNode
classes.description: Base class for all parse tree nodes, providing JSON serialization and type identification methods.

classes.name: LiteralNode
classes.description: Represents literal values such as booleans, integers, and strings.

classes.name: ListNode
classes.description: Represents a list of parse nodes, supporting sorting and deduplication.

classes.name: BinaryOpNode
classes.description: Represents binary operations like addition or comparison.

classes.name: BlockNode
classes.description: Represents a block of statements, with execution and JSON serialization.

classes.name: FunctionCallNode
classes.description: Represents a function call with arguments and optional block.

classes.name: EndNode
classes.description: Represents an end token in the parse tree.

classes.name: BlockCommentNode
classes.description: Represents a block comment in the source code.

classes.name: AccessorNode
classes.description: Represents member or array access expressions.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the parse node within a given scope, returning a value.

methods.name: GetRange
methods.description: Returns the source code location range of the node.

methods.name: MakeErrorDescribing
methods.description: Creates an error object with a message and help text.

methods.name: GetJSONNode
methods.description: Serializes the node to a JSON representation.

methods.name: BuildFromJSON
methods.description: Constructs a parse node from a JSON object.

methods.name: SetNewLocation
methods.description: Updates the source location of the node.
